summary: Iteration 6 frontend-only validation. critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Inspections.jsx 'Send Photos' dialog only opens after a save that includes photos. Skipping is destructive — once dismissed there is no UI to re-send photos for the same inspection. Consider adding an 'Enviar fotos por correo' action on the order/inspection detail later.

Minor: CheckIn.jsx searches by plate via the same endpoint as code; backend behavior was not unit-tested here (existing plate TAB123 verified, non-existent ADB123 returned 404). Confirm 'Debe esperar' time_validation branch still fires for plate hits scheduled in the future.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing agendado order TAB123 (VMHVJQ3F) for plate-search positive case and 5 existing 'ingresado' orders (TGJ643, AWS345, ING001, etc.) for the inspection flow.
